text: Not sure if I'm overreacting... my 2yo has a temp of 38.7. She's got quite a sore red nappy rash, I think it's bothering her. I did the glass thing on it just in case and it goes pale when you press, so I think that's ok? She's wide awake and chatty, wakes up easy, seems herself really. I suppose I just want to know if there's anything else I should be doing, or if it can wait till the GP tomorrow.
